repos_data.description: Market risk regime (calm/elevated/crash) for AI agents on Base — free to read via MCP. Signed EIP-712 risk attestations as portable proof-of-diligence, plus a collateral-backed treasury index for idle USDC with JIT swap to USDC for x402 invoices.
Typed zero-dependency client for the US Treasury FiscalData API — Debt to the Penny, interest & exchange rates. No API key.
US TIPS inflation math per 31 CFR 356 App B — reference CPI, index ratios, adjusted principal, deflation floor. Zero dependencies.
US Treasury price math — parse & format 32nds quotes (105-16+), ticks, and basis points. Zero dependencies.
